spec.description: Raft state for all Quorum Queues running in a RabbitMQ cluster

spec.title: Raft members with >5k entries in the log
spec.description:
##### Number of entries in the Raft log

Tracks the number of Raft log entries since the last snapshot.

Large values can either be indicative of large quorum queue backlogs or availability problems. If the uncommitted entries metric is large as well, there is a genuine availability problem in the system.

spec.expr:
sum(
  (rabbitmq_raft_log_last_written_index * on(instance, job) group_left(rabbitmq_cluster, rabbitmq_node) rabbitmq_identity_info{rabbitmq_cluster=~"$rabbitmq_cluster", rabbitmq_endpoint="$endpoint"}) - 
  (rabbitmq_raft_log_snapshot_index * on(instance) group_left(rabbitmq_cluster, rabbitmq_node) rabbitmq_identity_info{rabbitmq_cluster=~"$rabbitmq_cluster", rabbitmq_endpoint="$endpoint"})
) by(queue, rabbitmq_node)

sum(
  (rabbitmq_raft_last_written_index * on(instance, job) group_left(rabbitmq_cluster, rabbitmq_node) rabbitmq_identity_info{rabbitmq_cluster=~"$rabbitmq_cluster", rabbitmq_endpoint="$endpoint"}) - 
  (rabbitmq_raft_snapshot_index * on(instance) group_left(rabbitmq_cluster, rabbitmq_node) rabbitmq_identity_info{rabbitmq_cluster=~"$rabbitmq_cluster", rabbitmq_endpoint="$endpoint"})
) by(queue, rabbitmq_node)

spec.title: Uncommitted log entries
spec.description:
##### Pending Raft log entries

Tracks the number of Raft log entries that have been written but not yet committed.

High & growing values may be indicative of a quorum of members not being available so that a queue can make progress.

spec.expr:
sum(
  (rabbitmq_raft_log_last_written_index * on(instance, job) group_left(rabbitmq_cluster, rabbitmq_node) rabbitmq_identity_info{rabbitmq_cluster=~"$rabbitmq_cluster", rabbitmq_endpoint="$endpoint"}) -
  (rabbitmq_raft_log_commit_index * on(instance, job) group_left(rabbitmq_cluster, rabbitmq_node) rabbitmq_identity_info{rabbitmq_cluster=~"$rabbitmq_cluster", rabbitmq_endpoint="$endpoint"})
) by(rabbitmq_node)

sum(
  (rabbitmq_raft_last_written_index * on(instance, job) group_left(rabbitmq_cluster, rabbitmq_node) rabbitmq_identity_info{rabbitmq_cluster=~"$rabbitmq_cluster", rabbitmq_endpoint="$endpoint"}) -
  (rabbitmq_raft_commit_index * on(instance, job) group_left(rabbitmq_cluster, rabbitmq_node) rabbitmq_identity_info{rabbitmq_cluster=~"$rabbitmq_cluster", rabbitmq_endpoint="$endpoint"})
) by(rabbitmq_node)

spec.title: Leader elections / s
spec.description:
##### Rate of Raft leader elections

Tracks the increments of the Raft term.

Sustained non-zero rates are indicative of network and/or availability issues, or queue churn. The other reason may be quorum queue declarations.

Values above 0 are normal, some leader elections are expected. Sustained high values may be of concern.

spec.expr: sum(rate(rabbitmq_raft_term[$__rate_interval]) * on(instance, job) group_left(rabbitmq_cluster, rabbitmq_node) rabbitmq_identity_info{rabbitmq_cluster=~"$rabbitmq_cluster", rabbitmq_endpoint="$endpoint"}) by(rabbitmq_node)

spec.title: Log entries committed / s
spec.description:
##### Rate of Raft log operations committed

This includes all queue operations, including publishes & consumer acknowledgements.

This tracks the progress of the Raft commit index on all members, including followers.

If a RabbitMQ node does not run a Raft member, it will not report any entries committed.

spec.expr: sum(rate(rabbitmq_raft_log_commit_index[$__rate_interval]) * on(instance, job) group_left(rabbitmq_cluster, rabbitmq_node) rabbitmq_identity_info{rabbitmq_cluster=~"$rabbitmq_cluster", rabbitmq_endpoint="$endpoint"}) by(rabbitmq_node)

sum(rate(rabbitmq_raft_commit_index[$__rate_interval]) * on(instance, job) group_left(rabbitmq_cluster, rabbitmq_node) rabbitmq_identity_info{rabbitmq_cluster=~"$rabbitmq_cluster", rabbitmq_endpoint="$endpoint"}) by(rabbitmq_node)

spec.title: Log entry commit latency
spec.description:
##### Time for a log entry to be committed

This is an indicator of Raft operational overhead. Values will increase with increased load as the system trades latency for throughput.

This metric samples  the time it takes for a log entry to be written to a Raft log and that entry being committed.

Because quorum queues fsync all operations to disk before committing them, they are not suitable for low-latency workloads.

spec.expr: rabbitmq_raft_commit_latency_seconds * on(instance, job) group_left(rabbitmq_cluster, rabbitmq_node) rabbitmq_identity_info{rabbitmq_cluster=~"$rabbitmq_cluster", rabbitmq_endpoint="$endpoint"}
